title: Depósitos públicos en el  sistema financiero: más de US$ 3.100 millones - Economía - ABC Color
content: According to the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF), total public deposits in June 2024 were US$ 2.610 million, rising to US$ 2.671 million in August, then falling to US$ 2.536 million in September due to lower demand for demand deposits and Savings Deposit Certificates (CDA). In October deposits spiked to US$ 2.807 million, falling again to US$ 2.422 million in December. Early 2025 saw a further decline to US$ 2.517 million in January, the lowest point of the series, but the trend turned upward thereafter. The largest increase occurred in June–July 2025, when deposits reached US$ 2.859 million and then US$ 3.152 million, the highest level recorded. By August 2025 deposits were US$ 3.142 million. Demand deposits more than doubled from US$ 711 million in June 2024 to US$ 1.106 million in August 2025, while CDA rose from US$ 1.672 million to US$ 1.742 million. The current account remained stable around US$ 250 million, ending at US$ 295 million in August 2025. In August 2024, foreign‑currency balances of state entities were US$ 636.6 million, of which 75.7 % were demand deposits (US$ 481.7 million) and 23.4 % were CDA (US$ 149.1 million). Local‑currency public sector balances reached G. 18.37 billion, with 63.6 % in CDA (G. 11.68 billion), 24.9 % in demand deposits (G. 4.57 billion) and 11.5 % in current accounts (G. 2.12 billion).

title: Bankalardaki mevduat 25 trilyon liraya yaklaştı - Para Haberleri
content: According to data from the Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BDDK), total deposits in banks held by domestic and foreign residents reached 24 trillion 968 billion 332 million Turkish lira by the last week of September 2025, representing a 31.4% increase from the beginning of the year. Of this, 14 trillion 541 billion 995 million lira was held in accounts of real individuals. Total deposits rose from 18 trillion 998 billion 750 million lira at the end of the previous year to 24 trillion 968 billion 332 million lira over the 9-month period, an increase of 5 trillion 969 billion 582 million lira. Real individuals' deposits increased by 3 trillion 258 billion 49 million lira, or 28.9%, compared to the end of the previous year, reaching 14 trillion 541 billion 995 million lira. Deposits from commercial entities rose by 31.41% to 8 trillion 513 billion 921 million lira over the same period, up from 6 trillion 478 billion 777 million lira at the end of the prior year, an increase of 2 trillion 35 billion 144 million lira. Among deposit categories, the largest increase occurred in official and other institutions' accounts, with a 54.7% rise, growing from 1 trillion 236 billion 26 million lira at the end of 2024 to 1 trillion 912 billion 415 million lira by the end of September 2025.

title: Subió el plazo fijo: cuánto rinde invertir $700.000 a 30 días en agosto de 2025
content: In August 2025, fixed-term deposits are offering returns of up to 48.5% annual. With inflation decreasing and interest rates stabilized, fixed-term deposits have become a viable investment option for conservative savers. Banks, both traditional and digital, have adjusted their offers, with rates ranging from 44% to 48.5% TNA. The highest rates currently available in the market reach a 48.5% TNA, offered by leading financial institutions. According to calculations, the monthly return for investing $700,000 in a 30-day fixed-term deposit varies between $23,300 and $28,300, depending on the nominal annual rate offered by each entity. 'The difference between the extremes can exceed $5,000 in just one month, reflecting the impact of each bank's conditions on the final result of the investment.'

title: Comprehensive 2025 Open Banking Market Intelligence: Navigate Expansion to 2034
content: The open banking market is projected to grow from $30.89 billion in 2024 to $38.71 billion in 2025, reflecting a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 25.3%. Forecasted expansion continues, with the market expected to reach $93.38 billion by 2029 at a CAGR of 24.6%. Key growth drivers include increased online platform usage, urbanization, the rise of younger generations, fintech adoption, mergers and acquisitions, and digital payment system evolution. The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) in India processed $1.497 trillion in transaction value by end-2022, accounting for nearly 86% of India’s GDP, underscoring the impact of digital payment infrastructure. Leading segments include Transactional Services (e.g., Payment Initiation, Account Aggregation), Communicative Services (e.g., Alerts, Messaging), and Informative Services (e.g., Financial Analytics, Credit Scoring). Deployment models span Cloud, On-Premises, and Hybrid. Regional growth highlights North America as the largest market in 2024, with Asia-Pacific projected as the fastest-growing region. Major market players include Banco Santander, BBVA, HSBC, Citigroup, DBS Bank, Barclays, HDFC Bank, Wise, Microsoft, IBM, Amazon Web Services, and others. Emerging trends include the adoption of big data, Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS), personalization, variable recurring payments, strategic alliances, and API-driven platforms such as Scotiabank’s Scotia TranXact, which enables real-time payments and account information access for business clients.

title: Bankalardaki mevduat eylül ayı itibarıyla 25 trilyon liraya yaklaştı
content: According to data from the Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BDDK), total deposits in Turkish banks reached 24 trillion 968 billion 332 million lira by the end of the last week of September 2024, a 31.4% increase from the beginning of the year. Of this, 14 trillion 541 billion 995 million lira was held in accounts of individuals. Total deposits rose from 18 trillion 998 billion 750 million lira at the end of last year to 24 trillion 968 billion 332 million lira over nine months, an increase of 5 trillion 969 billion 582 million lira. Individual deposits increased by 3 trillion 258 billion 49 million lira (28.9% growth) over the same period. The highest proportional increase, at 54.7%, occurred in the deposits of public and other institutions, which rose from 1 trillion 236 billion 26 million lira to 1 trillion 912 billion 415 million lira. Commercial entities' deposits rose by 31.41% to 8 trillion 513 billion 921 million lira. Insurance-related deposits increased by 41.4% to 6 trillion 198 billion 538 million lira. Meanwhile, Kur Korumalı Türk Lirası Mevduat ve Katılma Hesapları (KKM) fell by 74.1% to 292 billion 805 million lira, down from 1 trillion 129 billion 899 million lira at the end of December 2024. This decline followed measures by the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey (TCMB), including ending new account openings and renewals for legal entities in February and for individuals (excluding YUVAM accounts) from August 23, with the process officially concluded and relevant regulations lifted upon maturity of all accounts.

title: 央行：前三季度人民币存款增加22.71万亿元 住户存款增加12.73万亿元_腾讯新闻
content: According to data released by the People's Bank of China on October 15, 2025, RMB deposits increased by 22.71 trillion yuan in the first three quarters of 2025. This includes a 12.73 trillion yuan increase in household deposits, 1.53 trillion yuan in non-financial corporate deposits, 1.37 trillion yuan in fiscal deposits, and 4.81 trillion yuan in non-banking financial institution deposits. The total social financing scale stock reached 437.08 trillion yuan by the end of September 2025, up 8.7% year-on-year. Of this, loans to the real economy in RMB amounted to 267.03 trillion yuan, up 6.4% year-on-year, while foreign currency loans to the real economy declined by 18%. Government bond balances rose 20.2% year-on-year to 92.55 trillion yuan, accounting for 21.2% of the total social financing scale, up 2.1 percentage points. The total social financing scale increment for the first three quarters was 30.09 trillion yuan, 4.42 trillion yuan more than the same period last year. M2 money supply grew 8.4% year-on-year to 335.38 trillion yuan, while M1 grew 7.2% to 113.15 trillion yuan. RMB loans increased by 14.75 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, with household loans rising 1.1 trillion yuan and corporate loans increasing 13.44 trillion yuan. The foreign exchange reserve stood at 3.34 trillion U.S. dollars as of September 30, 2025, with the RMB exchange rate at 7.1055 yuan per U.S. dollar. Cross-border RMB settlement in current accounts reached 13.06 trillion yuan, and direct investment settlement reached 6.04 trillion yuan. All figures are preliminary data.

title: 예금자보호한도 상향 1주일...5대 은행 정기예금 오히려 늘었다
content: On September 9, 2025, 연합뉴스 reported that the deposit‑protection limit in South Korea was raised from 50 million KRW to 100 million KRW a week earlier, yet there was no sign of a mass shift of funds to non‑bank financial institutions. According to the Bank of Korea, the total savings‑type deposits in commercial banks stood at 3.4 trillion KRW, a rise of 300 billion KRW from the previous period. The five major banks—KB Kookmin, Shinhan, Hana, Woori, and NH Nonghyup—reported a combined fixed‑deposit balance of 958.84 trillion KRW on August 8, up 3.3521 trillion KRW from the end‑of‑August figure of 954.7319 trillion KRW. Fixed‑savings deposits also grew by 3,207 billion KRW, from 44.22737 trillion KRW to 44.59444 trillion KRW. A bank spokesperson said, '정기 예·적금 잔액이 늘어나, 예금자보호한도 상향에 따른 2금융권으로의 자금 이동은 제한적인 것으로 추정된다.' Another said, '금리 인하기라 예금 상품 금리 격차가 크지 않기도 하고, 고객이 2금융권에 자금을 예치할 때 해당 기관의 건전성을 까다롭게 따지는 경향도 계속되고 있다.' The Bank of Korea’s July average interest rate for savings deposits was 2.51 %, while the only 3 %‑range rate came from the mutual savings bank at 3.02 %. Other 2‑bank rates were in the 2 % range. Demand deposits fell slightly, from 10.3466 trillion KRW to 10.3336 trillion KRW, but the decline was attributed to a shift to asset markets rather than to the 2‑bank sector. Regulators noted that the overall flow of deposits remained similar to previous periods and that any movement would likely be gradual.

title: 银行行业专题研究：六问存款到期
content: The article analyzes the impact of high‑interest fixed‑deposit (FD) maturities in 2025‑2026 on Chinese banks. In 2025, total FD maturities reach 112 trillion yuan, of which 72 trillion yuan are high‑interest and 40 trillion yuan are low‑interest; the second half of 2025 alone accounts for about 50 trillion yuan, with 37 trillion yuan of high‑interest FDs. In 2026, total maturities fall to roughly 79 trillion yuan, split evenly between the first and second halves. Maturities cluster in late 2025 (September, December) and early 2026 (Q1). From January to July 2025, new general deposits grew by nearly 10 trillion yuan, with retail deposits outperforming corporate deposits. Corporate fixed‑deposit and non‑bank deposits show seasonal swings, indicating that after high‑interest FDs mature, these funds often shift to wealth‑management or equities. Banks renew high‑interest FDs at a rate exceeding 100 %—new deposits surpass maturing deposits—yet corporate deposit growth is noticeably smaller than in previous years. Renewal is mainly via end‑of‑month and quasi‑daily deposits, a strategy that preserves timing but weakens daily average liquidity, leading to higher asset‑liability mismatch and increased market‑rate volatility. Large banks mitigate the liquidity gap by absorbing policy‑tool deposits, interbank deposits, and balanced‑maturity interbank certificates of deposit (CDs). Small banks adopt a more aggressive short‑term interbank‑CD strategy, heightening duration‑mismatch risk and increasing reliance on central‑bank policy and large‑bank net lending. The high‑interest FD maturities reduce liability costs by about 15 basis points for large banks in 2025 H2, with projected end‑of‑year rates of 1.5 % and 1.65 % respectively. In 2026, the improvement is estimated at 12 basis points, suggesting diminishing returns and a future focus on interbank liability costs. The article also discusses whether lower liability costs could stimulate bond allocation in the money‑market sector; while theory suggests a downward FTP spread could lower bond yield requirements, practical lag and daily FTP updates limit immediate impact. The author advises monitoring Shibor or CD‑vs‑treasury spreads as proxies for FTP changes. Risks highlighted include a sluggish economic recovery, insufficient monetary‑policy support, and potential measurement errors.

title: US Bank Reserves Rise, Surpassing $3 Trillion
content: U.S. bank reserves rose by approximately $54 billion to $3.034 trillion by the week ending October 8, 2025, marking the first increase in nine weeks and surpassing the $3 trillion threshold for the first time since July 2020. This rise follows an eight-week decline, the longest such period since July 2020, which was driven by increased U.S. Treasury debt issuance to rebuild cash balances after the debt ceiling was raised in July. That issuance drained liquidity from Federal Reserve liabilities, including the overnight reverse repurchase (RRP) agreements and bank reserves. The recent uptick in reserves is attributed to the RRP facility nearing depletion, which halted the prior downward trend. The data, released by the Federal Reserve, is being monitored by the Federal Reserve as it evaluates further balance sheet reductions. The report was generated using automated technology and reviewed by the GuruFocus editorial team.

title: 오늘부터 예금보호 1억원까지...머니무브 일어날까?
content: The Korean Financial Authority has raised the deposit‑protection limit from 50 million won to 100 million won, effective September 1, 2025, marking the first increase in 24 years since 2001. The new limit applies to deposits at banks, savings banks, insurance companies, credit unions, agricultural and rural cooperatives, and community savings banks.  Retirement pension plans (DC and IRP) and ISA accounts are protected up to 100 million won only if they are operated as deposit‑type products.  The expansion is expected to reduce the inconvenience of spreading deposits across multiple institutions and could trigger a ‘money‑move’ toward higher‑yielding savings banks.  For instance, the average annual interest rate on one‑year fixed deposits at savings banks was 3.04 % last month, 0.56 % higher than the 2.48 % offered by banks.  However, analysts note that the current interest‑rate spread between banks and savings banks is only about 0.21 % per month, which may not be enough to motivate large‑scale fund transfers in the short term.  One researcher said, '2024년 이후 은행과 저축은행 간 월평균 정기예금 금리차는 약 0.21%p에 불과해 예금자 입장에서 자금을 이전할 만큼의 유인이 크지 않다.'  Another warned that the increase could concentrate deposits in large savings banks, potentially raising their risk profile: '보호한도 상향으로 중소형 저축은행에서 대형 저축은행으로 자금 편중이 심화될 것으로 예상된다.'  The Financial Services Commission will monitor fund movements through a task force and pay special attention to the fourth quarter when deposit maturities cluster.  The new limit will lift the share of protected deposits from 49 % to 58 % of total deposits, an increase of 241 billion won.
